title: the fourth floor walk-up Rising
author: P. M. Dunmore
blurb: Freya Montrose, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
